mapper.select: SELECT request_no as requestNo, request_name as requestName FROM special_request

select (select keyword.keyword_name from keyword where keyword_no = acm.keyword_no) as keywordName, (select category.category_name from category where category_no = acm.category_no) as categoryName, acm.accommodation_no as accommodationNo, acm.accommodation_name as accommodationName, acm.accommodation_address as accommodationAddress, acm.accommodation_contents as accommodationContents, acm.checkin, acm.checkout, acm.tel,
rm.room_name as roomName, rm.room_qty as roomQty, rm.room_price as roomPrice, rm.room_discount as roomDiscount, rm.room_contents as roomContents, rm.room_viewtype as roomViewtype, rm.room_capacity as roomCapacity from accommodation acm inner join room rm on acm.accommodation_no = rm.accommodation_no where rm.room_no = #{room_no};
